characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Young woman, fair complexion, bright pink hair tied back. Glowing, semi-transparent holographic appearance.

characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Young man, average build, dark hair.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: Why can't I speak English? Everyone at the office speaks so fast, I just freeze.
Miss Nova says: That is because you never practice speaking. I will analyze your level and build a custom plan just for you.
Rahul says: But who are you?
Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova, your AI English teacher on Supernova AI.
Rahul says: How will that help me?
Miss Nova says: I make you actually speak. We will practice real-life situations, like your next job interview.
Miss Nova says: If you get stuck, I will explain the logic in your own language so you never feel lost.
Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes. I am always here, and I will never judge you or laugh at you.
Miss Nova says: Stop wasting hours scrolling feeds. Talk to me for just fifteen minutes a day.
Miss Nova says: Install Supernova AI, and start seeing visible progress in your speaking within a month.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable workplace English anxiety
- Payload: Lands personalization (a), privacy (b), speaking (c), scenarios (e), and logic in mother tongue (g)
- Close: Negative/positive time anchors and hedged progress expectation
